corpus.title: SSO via Okta
corpus.description: Our IT team requires everyone to sign in through Okta single sign-on so that we can enforce company security policies and offboard people instantly.

corpus.title: Okta login
corpus.description: Please let us log in with our Okta accounts instead of separate passwords. Managing a second password for every employee is a security risk.

corpus.title: Login with Google
corpus.description: Allow users to sign in with their Google account so new people can join without creating another password.

corpus.title: Export reports to CSV
corpus.description: We need to export the monthly reports as CSV files so that our finance team can reconcile invoices without copying data by hand.

corpus.title: Download dashboard data as a spreadsheet
corpus.description: I want to download the report data from the dashboard into Excel so I can do my own analysis and share it with finance.

corpus.title: Import contacts from CSV
corpus.description: Let us upload a CSV file of contacts to create many contacts at once instead of adding them one by one.

corpus.title: Dark mode
corpus.description: Add a dark mode for the web app. Working late at night the bright white screen is hard on the eyes.

corpus.title: Night theme to reduce eye strain
corpus.description: A darker colour theme for night time use would reduce eye strain.

corpus.title: Slack notifications for new comments
corpus.description: Send a Slack message when someone comments on a task I follow so I don't miss feedback.

corpus.title: Weekly email digest
corpus.description: A weekly email summarising activity on my projects so I can catch up on Monday mornings.

corpus.title: Two-factor authentication
corpus.description: Add two-factor authentication to protect accounts. Our compliance audit requires it.

corpus.title: 2FA with an authenticator app
corpus.description: Support 2FA codes from Google Authenticator or 1Password when logging in.

corpus.title: Bulk edit tasks
corpus.description: Select multiple tasks and change their status or assignee at once. Editing 50 tasks one by one takes hours.

corpus.title: Change several tasks at the same time
corpus.description: I want to update the status of many tasks in one action instead of opening each task.

corpus.title: Change button color on settings page
corpus.description: The save button on the settings page should be blue instead of grey. Minor cosmetic thing.

corpus.title: Offline mode for mobile app
corpus.description: Let field technicians use the mobile app offline and sync when they are back online.

corpus.title: Fix broken password reset email
corpus.description: Password reset emails never arrive, so users who forget their password are blocked and cannot log in. Customers are contacting support every day.

corpus.title: Password reset emails are not arriving
corpus.description: I clicked forgot password three times and no email ever came. I am locked out of my account until this works.

corpus.title: Reset password by SMS
corpus.description: Offer a text message code as an alternative way to reset a forgotten password, for users who no longer have access to their work email.

corpus.title: Export tasks to PDF
corpus.description: Print the task list of a project as a PDF document so we can attach it to client status updates.

corpus.title: Recurring tasks
corpus.description: Create tasks that repeat on a schedule, for example a compliance check every Monday or an invoice reminder each month.

corpus.title: Repeat a task every week
corpus.description: I have to recreate the same task by hand each week. Let a task come back automatically on a weekly cycle.

cases.name: cosmetic button colour

cases.name: report export for finance
cases.underlyingNeed: Finance needs report data in a reusable format to reconcile invoices without manual copying.

cases.underlyingNeed: Field technicians need to keep working without connectivity.
